title: JetBrains Junie
description: JetBrains Junie CLI (junie.jetbrains.com; CLI beta 2026-03). User config home is ~/.junie/ per Junie CLI docs — Junie documents NO env override for relocating that directory (JUNIE_CONFIG_LOCATION only adds an extra config file), so the JUNIE_HOME entry under configHome.env is gsd-core-local plumbing that redirects GSD-managed installer writes only (FACTORY_HOME precedent); Junie itself does not recognise it. Skills use the open Agent Skills format (skills/<name>/SKILL.md, Claude-compatible; project beats user on name conflict). Custom slash commands are flat .md files under commands/ with a description frontmatter — NOTE: Junie interpolates named $argumentName placeholders, not $ARGUMENTS, so GSD command bodies are emitted verbatim and their $ARGUMENTS token is passed through uninterpolated (documented limitation). Subagents are flat .md files under agents/ with near-Claude frontmatter (description required; name/tools/mcpServers/model optional) — emitted verbatim per the zcode precedent. Junie hooks live under a 'hooks' key in ~/.junie/config.json (7 events: SessionStart, UserPromptSubmit, PreToolUse, Stop, StopFailure, PermissionRequest, SessionEnd — no PostToolUse); supporting them requires a dedicated junie-config-json hooks/install surface (new validator enums + writer + golden-parity coverage), so v1 ships artifact-only (hooksSurface none, installSurface profile-marker-only) and hook registration is deferred. Project instructions: .junie/AGENTS.md, root AGENTS.md, legacy .junie/guidelines.md. MCP via .junie/mcp/mcp.json. Tier-2 support (parity eligibility, not primary).
